target_customer: Frontier AI labs buying training data and RL environments for engineering and computer use agents
problem: Models lack high fidelity examples of expert work in CAD and enterprise software, which are hard to source at scale.
business_model: Data sales to AI labs (datasets and RL environments), with open source datasets for visibility
product_category: Expert workflow data and RL environments for AI

founders.name: Dev Mandal
founders.background_notes: Youngest team member at Sarvam per a profile.

competitors.name: Turing
competitors.what: Software talent platform packaging UI and MCP environments with verifiers for frontier labs
competitors.traction_then: Described as closest direct competitor in computer use work

competitors.name: Surge AI
competitors.what: Established labeling vendor moving into RL environments

competitors.name: Mercor
competitors.what: Expert marketplace that acquired Sepal AI in February 2026 for environment work

technical_complexity.rationale: Capturing screen and action data and building rubric graded CAD tasks is operational and tooling work with expert sourcing as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Expert networks and tooling can be matched by larger data vendors, and labs may build in house.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large vendors already bundled environments and labor in 2026; one secondary analysis says OpenAI is building in house data capacity.

market_need_then: Labs were buying RL environments heavily in 2025 and 2026 and TechCrunch covered Silicon Valley betting on environments to train agents in September 2025.

branding.domain_note: Uses markovstudios.com, not markov.com; many other companies use Markov (MarkovML, a robotics firm with a pending trademark).

identity.visual_style: Dataset showcase site with open data viewers

branding.brand_signature: Open source datasets on Hugging Face with several hundred thousand downloads
branding.community_and_virality: Open datasets and benchmarks such as AutoCAD Bench draw researcher use; company site shows 835,530 Hugging Face downloads, while a YC launch post says 150K.

brand_strength.rationale: Early and mainly known among researchers; the name is shared with unrelated companies.

outcome_analysis: Markov is a Summer 2026 data company selling expert workflow datasets and CAD RL environments to labs. It reports sales of 15,000 hours and large open downloads but no verified funding; the market is crowded with funded vendors, so it is too early to judge an outcome.
notes: Dealroom lists a 125K seed, single aggregator source, unverified and not recorded as a round. Figures such as 10,000 CAD environments and 500,000 hours are company reported and differ across pages (a Hugging Face card shows about 12,300 hours open, another report 51 CAD workflows). A CleverX claim that DeepMind acqui-hired Mechanize is unconfirmed and not used. Competitor dates are year level.
